banner.title: Elderly care, connected in real time
banner.subtitle: MediBridge centralizes clinical monitoring, family communication, and care management for elderly care centers and home-care environments - giving families peace of mind and caregivers powerful tools.

solution.title: The Problem We Solve
solution.subtitle: Fragmented communication, manual records, and non-integrated systems make elderly care harder to coordinate.
solution.problemText: Many care providers still rely on manual records or tools that do not connect clinical updates, medication logs, and family communication. This leaves families dependent on calls, messages, or visits to understand a loved one's status.
solution.operationalText: Care staff often repeat information across paper notes, spreadsheets, and messaging apps. MediBridge helps reduce that administrative load by centralizing records, alerts, medication updates, and shift continuity in one workflow.
solution.missionText: Design secure, scalable digital solutions that improve elderly care by integrating clinical information, family communication, and operational workflows.
solution.visionText: Become a trusted Latin American health-tech startup for elderly care software, delivering reliable tools that scale across care centers, rest homes, and home-care environments.

profiles.title: Who Is MediBridge For?
profiles.subtitle: Two key segments, one connected ecosystem of care.
profiles.familyText: Direct relatives who need real-time visibility into their loved one's health status, clinical alerts, and direct communication with caregivers - without depending on informal channels.
profiles.caregiverText: Nurses, technicians, and caregivers who need to centralize clinical records, medication updates, alerts, and information continuity between shifts.

features.title: Platform Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need for safe, efficient, and transparent elderly care.
features.vitalsText: Track key indicators from one dashboard so families and care teams can follow changes quickly.
features.alertsText: Notify authorized users when clinical values or care events require timely attention.
features.medsText: Organize medication schedules, inventory, reminders, and administration records in one place.
features.chatText: Keep family updates and caregiver messages organized around each care case.
features.reportsText: Generate concise summaries and downloadable reports for follow-up and medical consultations.
features.shiftsText: Share handoff notes and pending tasks so every shift starts with the right context.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From registration to real-time monitoring in four simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Text: The care center or caregiver creates an account and adds residents, staff, and family members.
howItWorks.step2Text: Caregivers log vital signs, medications, and daily activities through the mobile app.
howItWorks.step3Text: Families access real-time dashboards, receive alerts, and communicate with staff.
howItWorks.step4Text: Weekly reports and analytics help optimize care plans and prevent complications.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about MediBridge.
faq.q1: How does MediBridge protect patient health data?
faq.a1: MediBridge uses authenticated access, role-based permissions, and secure API communication to restrict sensitive clinical information according to each user profile.
faq.q2: Do caregivers need technical skills to use the platform?
faq.a2: No. MediBridge is designed with simple workflows, clear dashboards, and guided actions so caregivers can register key information quickly during daily care routines.
faq.q3: Can family members access the platform from abroad?
faq.a3: Yes. Family members can access updates, reports, alerts, and messages remotely as long as they have an authorized account and internet access.
faq.q4: What happens if the internet goes down at the facility?
faq.a4: Real-time updates may be temporarily interrupted. The platform should prioritize critical workflows and synchronize information once connectivity is restored, depending on the final implementation.
faq.q5: Is there a free trial for nursing homes?
faq.a5: Care centers can request a demo or pilot plan to evaluate MediBridge before adopting an institutional subscription.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.introText: Welcome to MediBridge, a digital platform developed by VitalSync for the centralized monitoring and management of elderly care. These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our web and mobile applications. By accessing or using MediBridge, you agree to comply with these terms.
terms.ethicsText: VitalSync adheres to the ethical principles established by the ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics and the Code of Ethics of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Peru (CIP). Our development practices are guided by the following commitments:
terms.ethics1: Act consistently with the public interest, ensuring that our software serves the well-being of elderly patients and their families.
terms.ethics2: Maintain the highest standards of professional competence and integrity in the design, development, and maintenance of our platform.
terms.ethics3: Ensure that our products and modifications meet the highest professional standards, prioritizing patient safety and data confidentiality.
terms.ethics4: Promote an inclusive and respectful environment, ensuring that our platform is accessible to users with varying levels of digital literacy.
terms.dataText: MediBridge handles sensitive clinical data including vital signs, medical records, medication logs, and personal information. We implement the following safeguards:
terms.data1: JWT-based authentication with role-based access control (RBAC) to restrict data access by user role.
terms.data2: Encrypted data storage and transmission using industry-standard protocols.
terms.data3: Audit logging for all critical operations including medication administration and health record modifications.
terms.data4: Compliance with Peruvian data protection regulations (Ley N 29733, Ley de Proteccion de Datos Personales).
terms.useText: Users agree to use MediBridge solely for its intended purpose of elderly care monitoring and communication. Prohibited activities include unauthorized access attempts, data manipulation, and use of the platform for any purpose that could harm patients or compromise care quality.

VitalSync is not liable for clinical decisions made solely based on platform data. Users should always consult qualified healthcare professionals for medical decisions.
